meta.subtitle: First-time task reviews and PR-aware guarded browser personas · structure only
meta.spineDesc: Guided setup or CLI -> run orchestration -> guarded entry checks and persona walks -> deterministic judge and execution health -> portable local HTML, Markdown and JSON. Retests reuse recorded personas; optional publication remains separate.

bands.d: Ways to invoke the same runner
Changed files → journeys → people and devices

modules.label: CLI
modules.desc: Guided start, recorded-plan retest and existing run, replay, publication and MCP commands. Exit 2 distinguishes incomplete execution from the defect gate.

modules.label: MCP run manager
modules.desc: Stdio tools launch detached CLI processes, track local run directories, limit concurrency to two runs, and terminate process groups. Auth output stays in a private log.

modules.label: CI & AWS runners
modules.desc: GitHub Actions and AWS CodeBuild install the runner and browsers, supply trusted configuration and collect evidence. These workflows can upload artifacts and publish comments.

modules.label: Journey & persona planning
modules.desc: Changed-file ownership globs select journeys; the model can add unclaimed impacts. Saved personas fill seats before generation. Configured journey goals remain authoritative.

modules.label: Run orchestration
modules.desc: Coordinates guarded checks and persona walks, recording the full plan and unfinished attempts. Supports model-free entry checks and reused plans. Saves evidence before deriving local reports.

modules.label: Network write guard
modules.desc: One mitmdump proxy per browser. Pure policy evaluates requests; the addon enforces it, pins public DNS addresses, refuses forbidden writes and protocols, and records refusals and app 5xx responses. Every proxy must pass self-tests.

modules.label: Persona browser walks
modules.desc: browser-use drives vision-enabled Chromium sessions. Restricted actions open app pages and report issues with screenshots. Each walk records completion, tokens, issues and proxy-observed server errors.

modules.label: Entry-page checks
modules.desc: Plain Playwright checks each journey entry on desktop/mobile. Records HTTP status, page/console errors, failed requests and trial-click actionability; creates stable signal fingerprints.

modules.label: Issue consolidation
modules.desc: A model groups duplicate persona reports and identifies setup noise. Validates source IDs and lists omitted reports. Cannot remove hard signals or assign final severity.

modules.label: Deterministic verdicts
modules.desc: Pure deterministic findings and defect gate, separate from planned/completed execution health. Agent task completion is self-reported. Unfinished attempts do not become product journey failures.

modules.label: Possible fix suggestions
modules.desc: Opt-in model calls use journey-owned PR diff sections after excluding secret-like paths. At most five attempts; suggestions remain unverified and never change source code.

modules.label: Report rendering
modules.desc: Portable local HTML with ranked findings, embedded screenshots, next steps and retest observations, plus Markdown and JSON. Escapes untrusted text and makes incomplete execution explicit.

modules.label: Ticket generation
modules.desc: Rebuilds findings from evidence, groups by stable fingerprint and writes tickets.json. Optional GitHub issue creation/reopening deduplicates by author and hidden marker.

modules.label: GitHub integration
modules.desc: GitHub API client supports CLI tokens or GitHub App auth. Updates one sticky PR comment, commits optional screenshots in one batch, and writes Actions summaries.

modules.label: Configuration contract
modules.desc: Strict Pydantic models validate app origins, guard patterns, journeys, auth commands, model settings and budgets. YAML supplies all app-specific behavior; auth commands execute trusted local programs.

modules.label: Session preflight
modules.desc: Checks cookie scopes and configured signed-in JSON endpoints before browsers start. Refuses redirects, HTTP errors and unexpected response shapes. Runs outside the browser proxy.

modules.label: Model provider adapter
modules.desc: Supplies Bedrock, Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible chat models to planning, browser agents, consolidation and fixes. Handles Bedrock structured tool output and token accounting.

modules.label: Package & dependencies
modules.desc: Python 3.12 package version and dependency metadata. browser-use, Playwright, Pydantic and PyYAML are core; Bedrock and MCP are optional extras.

modules.label: First test & retest
modules.desc: Guided URL/task/audience setup saves a reusable YAML scenario. Retesting validates its settings, reuses recorded personas and compares observed finding groups without claiming fixes.
